reviews.title: Great cooler for the money! Big fan!
reviews.comment: I used to be all about the radiator until I got this thing! It cools extremely well - not quite as good as water, but so good that I've never experienced throttling, or even very high temperatures while playing games under heavy loads. It's easy to install, comes with all the parts you need clearly labeled. It looks stelar in my opinion. I know that some people are into the low profile of the radiators, but I actually like the Tron / Cyberpunk look of an enormous honking radiator through a glass case! This is easy to install too. I didn't have to put in a back plate at all. I just put down the Used it with a Ryzen 9 7900X And it works GREAT! Very quiet, very effective. And it costs WAY less than water-cooling for nearly the performance. If you're a hard core over-clocker, get the water cooler with liquid metal. Otherwise, buy this.
reviews.author: Argyle O'Hara

reviews.title: Budget CPU Cooler
reviews.comment: Great cooler, cools almost any mid to high end cpus and looks great!
reviews.author: Landon

reviews.title: Inexpensive and great performance
reviews.comment: Under appreciated compared to other more popular coolers but it's inexpensive, good cooling performance for a single tower, single fan, 6 heatpipe cooler that does not come close to blocking ram slots.  Dropped my full load CPU temps by about 15 degrees C compared to the stock ryzen 7600 cooler.  Stopped my cpu thermal throttling and got the cooler with one day delivery.  What more can you ask for?
reviews.author: "mattwk"

reviews.title: Easy Improvement for Cooling
reviews.comment: Noticed a CPU temp difference right away, easy to install and very quiet. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Matt Kellar

reviews.title: 20 to 30° difference from stock AM5, some bent fins but easy too fix
reviews.comment: Its cooling my 8500G Ryzen 5 20 to 30° cooler than stock so it's doin good for the price point,  there where a few bent fins but nothin i couldn't fix... would give it five stars but the few bent fins I didn't think it should get that many
